opening: I've started having trouble getting around on my left side; I keep bumping into things.
When I was 5, I had an operation to remove a brain tumour from the right back part of my brain; it was an anaplastic astrocytoma.
After that operation I had radiation therapy to my brain: 3D conformal external-beam radiotherapy, 6000 cGy in 30 sessions.
My last brain MRI was when I was 15.
